PartnerCompany.title: PartnerCompany
PartnerCompany.description: Public business directory entry for a King Pro Digital partner company, writable only by the authorized administrator.

name.description: Display name of the partner company

logoUrl.description: URL or compressed data URI for the company logo

logoBg.description: Preferred card background behind the logo for contrast

addressUrl.description: Optional Google Maps or address link

addressLabel.description: Optional short street address displayed on card

ownerId.description: UID of the administrator who created the record

PartnerCompanyStats.title: PartnerCompanyStats
PartnerCompanyStats.description: Per-link click counters for each partner company, readable only by the authorized administrator.

whatsappClicks.description: Total clicks on the WhatsApp button

instagramClicks.description: Total clicks on the Instagram button

addressClicks.description: Total clicks on the Address button

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last recorded click

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted administrator lookup document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/partner_companies/{companyId}.description: Collection of partner companies displayed on /empresasparceiras and /anuncios.

/partner_company_stats/{companyId}.description: Click counters per link for each partner company, readable only by the admin.
